generationMethod: local deterministic composition of existing project art and existing 1280x800 runtime captures

currentForgeSource.paintedObstruction: A fallen trunk and vines are baked into the right forest entrance. This cannot represent both blocked and cleared gameplay states without a selected separation or cleanup pass.

reviewBoard.localizedTextScope: Existing runtime screenshot evidence only. It is not production background or UI art.

candidateReviewSet.label: A / current balanced
pros: Preserves the original warm comic tropical painting without a grading change.
Beach, rock shelf, forest entrance, and shallow water remain balanced in one view.
concerns: The independent vine-wood barrier merges with dense right-side foliage.
The baked fallen trunk conflicts with a separate blocked/cleared state sprite.
The current right inventory rail can cover the forest interaction zone.

candidateReviewSet.label: B / gameplay-band contrast
pros: Provides the strongest silhouette separation for Kim, resource nodes, and the barrier.
Keeps the original camera framing and beach-to-water transition.
Maps cleanly to independent far, midground, gameplay-ground, and foreground grading layers.
concerns: The darker depth treatment is slightly flatter and must not become a full-screen tint.
Barrier placement must remain left of the persistent right inventory rail or that rail must collapse during exploration.
The baked fallen trunk still requires separation or a clean-path derivative after selection.

candidateReviewSet.label: C / shoreline-first
pros: Makes the shallow-water share and swim-entry slope easiest to read.
Preserves a broad central sand lane for Kim and resource nodes.
concerns: The forest route has less horizontal breathing room.
The barrier and later forest nodes are closer to the screen edge and UI rail.
The zoomed crop reduces the usefulness of the far-right environment for future search pockets.

recommendation.reason: It preserves the approved composition while giving Kim, the four resource silhouettes, the swim boundary, and the adopted barrier the strongest non-text contrast.
recommendation.condition: After explicit selection, produce separated grading layers and remove or isolate the baked fallen trunk before any runtime connection.

safeZones1280x800.rule: Critical player, node, swim-transition, and barrier silhouettes stay outside HUD, narration, compact prompt, bottom help, and any persistent inventory rail.

requiredStateSeparation.bakedFallenTrunk: remove from the selected clean background or isolate as a non-runtime reference layer
requiredStateSeparation.vineWoodBarrier: keep blocked/interactable/cleared as the existing independent true-alpha asset
requiredStateSeparation.resourceNodes: independent true-alpha sprites with contact pivots
requiredStateSeparation.swimBoundary: engine state/foam or mask; no text baked into the background

backgroundLayers.alphaIsTransparency: true for separated RGBA layers; false for the opaque far layer
backgroundLayers.compression: Uncompressed during review; high-quality platform compression only after selection

textContract.koEnQpsLong: handled by engine TMP in existing UI safe areas, never by this raster background package

wave11ConnectorIsolation.rule: Wave 14 coast-forest review does not select or package any Wave 11 connection-slot candidate.
